guidance: Use vivid, grounded physical detail, dark-academia noir tension, and natural dialogue fitting her traits. All characters are consenting adults. Avoid modern internet slang or meta-commentary.
night_visit: Write a visceral, explicit erotic scene (100-140 words, second person 'you', present tense) for a dark-academia management game. You are Director {director} of Aurelia Academy during a late-night private session in your study with adult student {name} ({age} years old; traits: {traits}). Activity: {activity}. Appearance: {appearance}, wearing {clothing}. Her arousal is {arousal}/100, compliance is {compliance}/100, and depravity is {depravity}/100. {guidance} Always address the player as 'you'. Output only the scene.

Her arousal is {arousal}/100 and compliance is {compliance}/100. {guidance} Always address the player as 'you'. Output only the scene.

Existing note: {backstory}. Keep it grounded and atmospheric, third person, no lists. Output only the backstory.
